title: Clearing a Work Tape
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean input word, let $m$ be a Boolean mode, let $e$ be an optional Boolean, and let $c$ be a configuration of the four-tape access machine on input $y$. Suppose every work-tape head of $c$ lies between $-1$ and the bit-length of $|y|+1$, and let $n\le |y|+1$. There is a finite sequence of access-machine steps, each taken from a configuration satisfying these head-position bounds, from the configuration obtained by setting tape $0$ to the binary word for $n$, placing its head at $0$, and setting the state to the clearing state with parameter $e$, to the configuration obtained by setting tape $0$ to blank, keeping its head at $0$, and setting the state to the exit state determined by $e$; all other configuration data are retained.
hypotheses_covered: all work-tape head positions are between -1 and the bit-length of |y|+1
